mutation_targets.rationale: F_NotesProvenance is the sole fact tying every ClinicalNote back to a unique permitted add_note Operation. Clearing it lets Alloy invent an orphan note with no creating op, which is exactly the structural shape of an out-of-band note mutation that the AppendOnly invariant must rule out.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NotesAppendOnly { some n: ClinicalNote | no op: Operation | op.noteCreated = n }

mutation_targets.rationale: F_AuditCompleteness is the load-bearing constraint that every authenticated clinical-endpoint Operation has exactly one matching AuditEntry. Removing it makes audit-write-skipping reachable; the injection forces a permitted record-read with no audit entry, which AuditCompleteness must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditMissing { some op: Operation | op.authenticated = True and op.kind = PostRecordsLookup and op.outcome = Permitted and (no ae: AuditEntry | ae.op = op) }

mutation_targets.rationale: F_RolePermissionGate is the only fact tying permitted Operations to the contracts/http-api.md permission matrix. Clearing it lets a clinician slip into the administrator-only audit-search endpoint with a permitted outcome, which LeastPrivilege must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilege { some op: Operation | op.outcome = Permitted and op.callerRoleSnapshot = Doctor and op.kind = PostAuditSearch }

mutation_targets.rationale: F_AuthRequired is the sole fact enforcing the FR-001 boundary (no permitted outcome and no audit entry when unauthenticated). Clearing it permits a permitted Operation with authenticated = False, which AuthRequiredEverywhere must reject.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuthBypass { some op: Operation | op.authenticated = False and op.outcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: F_CareTeamGating is the only fact requiring an active care-team-membership row for any permitted clinical-endpoint Operation. Clearing it lets a clinician permitted-read a patient they are not on the care team for, which OwnershipBasedAccess must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnershipBypass { some op: Operation | op.outcome = Permitted and op.kind = PostRecordsLookup and (no ctm: CareTeamMembership | ctm.ctmClinician = op.caller and ctm.ctmPatient = op.targetPatient and ctm.ctmActive = True) }

mutation_targets.rationale: F_NotFoundEnvelope is the only fact pinning denial / not-found Operations to the canonical NotFoundEnvelope response. Clearing it lets a denied Operation expose a distinguishable response shape — the classic existence-leak that FR-006 forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeakResponse { some op: Operation | op.authenticated = True and op.outcome = Denied and op.responseBytes != NotFoundEnvelope }

mutation_targets.rationale: F_AdminContentBlindness is the sole fact preventing the administrator's audit-search endpoint from serving a record-shaped or note-shaped response. F_PermittedClinicalResponses deliberately omits PostAuditSearch, so removing this fact opens the door to a hospital_administrator response carrying clinical content.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AdminLeak { some op: Operation | op.kind = PostAuditSearch and op.responseBytes = RecordOk }
